Row.Text: [ICON_IDEOLOGY_FREEDOM] Freedom [ICON_IDEOLOGY_FREEDOM]
This Great General/Admiral follows the ideology of Freedom and thus promote his or her soldiers/ships with defensive bonuses, fighting for the peacekeeping of freedom.
Freedom

Earn [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each killed equal to 100% of the enemy's [ICON_STRENGTH] strength. +1 [ICON_MOVES] Movement. +10% Defense. +15% [ICON_STRENGTH] Strength in both friendly and non-friendly territories.
[ICON_IDEOLOGY_ORDER] Order [ICON_IDEOLOGY_ORDER]
This Great General/Admiral follows the ideology of Order and thus promote his or her soldiers with medical bonuses, fighting for the power of the people.
Order

Earn [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each killed equal to 100% of the enemy's [ICON_STRENGTH] strength. +1 [ICON_MOVES] Movement. +5 HP regenerated. +20% [ICON_STRENGTH] Strength friendly and +10% [ICON_STRENGTH] in non-friendly territories.
[ICON_IDEOLOGY_AUTOCRACY] Autocracy [ICON_IDEOLOGY_AUTOCRACY]
This Great General/Admiral follows the ideology of Autocracy and thus promote his or her soldiers with offensive bonuses, ensuring security and continuing stability for a safe and secure world.
Autocracy

Earn [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each killed equal to 100% of the enemy's [ICON_STRENGTH] strength. +1 [ICON_MOVES] Movement. +25% [ICON_STRENGTH] toward wounded units. +10% [ICON_STRENGTH] Strength in friendly and +20% [ICON_STRENGTH] Strength in non-friendly territories.
Refinement (Trait)
This Great General/Admiral teaches nearby troops on how to study the battlefield and how to refine every aspect of war.
Recultivation (Trait)
This Great Experienced General/Admiral teaches nearby troops on how to cultivate the enemies' lands to be used against the enemies. Replaces [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Refinement[ENDCOLOR].
Reeducation (Trait)
This Great Veteran General/Admiral teaches nearby troops to "reeducate" and gather experience from any surviving enemy captives. Replaces [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Recultivation[ENDCOLOR].
Refinement

Receive [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 50% of the enemies' [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when you defeat them. Acquired when starting the turn near a Great General/Admiral with the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Refinement[ENDCOLOR] trait.
